units: <cite ref="Sotah 9a:7">Sot. 9ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 27:8">Is. XXVII, 8</cite>) <he>אין הקב״ה … עד שעת שִׁילּוּחָהּ</he> the Lord does not visit her sins upon a nation until the time comes to send her away (into captivity); <he>אין הקב״ה … שִׁילּוּחוֹ</he> the Lord does not punish a king, until the time comes to drive him away (depose him).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:1">Ḥull. XII, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>ש׳ הקן</he>, v. <cite ref="S01505"><he>קֵן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 140a:11">Ib. 140ᵃ</cite> <he>לש׳</he> with regard to the duty of letting the mother bird go. Sifra M’tsorʿa, Neg., Par. 1 <he>ש׳ ציפרים</he> letting the birds (of the leper’s sacrifice) fly (<cite ref="Leviticus 14:7">Lev. XIV, 7</cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 1:1:8">Y. B. Kam. I, 2ᵇ</cite> <he>פרשת ש׳ טמאין</he> the section treating of the sending out of the camp of the unclean (<cite ref="Numbers 5:1">Num. V, 1</cite> sq.).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:10">Num. R. s. 7<sup>10</sup></cite> <he>נתחייבו ש׳ וכ׳</he> they were condemned to be sent out of the camp, this means exile.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:7">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>שטר ש׳</he> a document referring to the sending away of children with gifts (<cite ref="Genesis 25:6">Gen. XXV, 6</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>שִׁילּוּחִים</he>, <he>שִׁילּוּחִין</he>, <cite ref="U00942"><he>שִׁלּ׳</he></cite>. Ḥull. l. c. <he>קודם שִׁלּוּחֶיהָ</he> before sending her off.

Snh. 102ᵃ (ref. to Mic. I, 14) מי … תתנו ש׳ לבניו he who slew the Philistine (Goliath) and gave you Gath as a possession:—will you give a dismissal to his descendants (will you abandon the house of David)?—Esp. שִׁילּוּחִין, שִׁלּ׳ banishment, exile.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>דנתי אותו בש׳</he> I punished him with banishment (from Eden); Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 1); a. e.
<cite ref="Yevamot 114b:17">Yeb. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ נחשים וכ׳</he> a plague of serpents and scorpions.—[Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵇ <he>בינה שילוח</he>, v. <cite ref="U00934"><he>שִׁילָא</he></cite>.]
